question: Does a bounded census of direct local-drain calls identify another command-five production-item source outside the accepted city-choice producer?

scope.callsiteLookback: 0x100 bytes before each exact local-drain call
scope.literalFilter: PowerPC addi rD,r0,5 (li rD,5) raw word
scope.stopCondition: Classify each nearby literal-five candidate or stop at the per-target direct-call cap; do not treat absence of that instruction shape as absence of type-five records.
scope.boundary: The scan covers direct calls in initialized executable memory and a fixed local lookback. It does not follow indirect calls, values loaded from memory or passed by callers, earlier record construction, or other command routes.

dependencies.use: Owns the accepted UI command-five producer and its direct local-drain branch.
Owns the observed command-five item write at city +0x38.
Defines the remaining non-menu source question for initialized IDs 233 through 236.

directCallCensus.localDrain: The raw direct-call scan found 27 calls to 0x82CE16C8 at cap 64, without truncation.
directCallCensus.separateSubmit: The same scan emitted 64 calls to 0x82CE1950 and reported truncation. It is not a complete submit-entry caller inventory.
directCallCensus.nearbyLiterals: Across 0x100-byte lookbacks for the 27 drain callsites, three pre-call li rD,5 sites were found: 0x82CD0570 before call 0x82CD0670, 0x82CEE6C0 before call 0x82CEE76C, and 0x82D24E0C before call 0x82D24EA4. A second window also overlapped 0x82CEE6C0 after an earlier call; it is not another pre-call candidate.

candidateClassification.result: The command record at stack +0xA0 receives literal type 2 at 0x82CD05DC. Register r30, initially set to 5 and conditionally changed to 2 or 3, is stored at record +0x08 at 0x82CD05E4. The literal is not the command type on this call path.
This is the already accepted 0x82CEE650 UI producer: literal type 5 is stored to its command record before the local-drain call.

Register r9 receives 5 and is moved to CTR at 0x82D24E44 for the five-word copy loop at 0x82D24E48 through 0x82D24E58. The copied record at stack +0xF0 receives its type from retained r20, initialized to 38 on this loop path; the nearby five is a copy count, not a command type.

currentEvidence.method: Two sequential foreground read-only canonical-project queries enumerated exact raw direct calls and then read 0x100-byte windows around only the 27 local-drain callsites. Narrow generated-code windows corroborated the two false literal-five candidates; the accepted UI producer was already mapped.
currentEvidence.qualification: The raw-word windows locate only immediate li rD,5 forms. The generated windows classify exact candidate register uses, not all commands in either large function. No new runtime behavior was observed.

guards: Do not conclude that 0x82CEE650 is the sole type-five producer from a local literal scan.
Do not treat the 64-site submit-entry result as exhaustive.
Do not infer that initialized wonder IDs 233 through 236 are globally invalid or unreachable from this negative result.
conclusion: The 27 direct local-drain callsites are an uncapped census, but the bounded 0x100-byte literal-five check identifies no additional type-five source. Its two apparent non-UI candidates use five as a record argument or copy count. Other command record producers and the capped separate submit route remain unresolved, so this packet does not supply a non-menu source for IDs 233 through 236.
